license_required.quote: A municipality shall not issue a construction permit for any home improvement or home elevation if any part of the home improvement or home elevation is to be performed by any contractor who is neither licensed pursuant to, nor exempt from the requirements of, the provisions of P.L.2023, c.237 (C.45:5AAA-1 et al.).
